title: Create maintenance record — typed with provider/dates/result
objective: Verify POST /maintenance creates a typed maintenance record (repair/inspection/upgrade per seeded types) with provider, technician, dates, issue, and that it appears on the asset.
preconditions: Operator session; asset M1 available; maintenance types seeded.
test_data: record {type 'Repair', issue 'Cracked screen', provider 'FixIt Ltd', technician, started date}
steps: POST /api/v1/maintenance with the payload + Idempotency-Key.
Verify response and record fields.
GET /assets/<M1>/history (or maintenance list filtered by asset) and verify record visible.
expected_result: 201 with record UUID; record linked to asset with all fields persisted; lifecycle + audit events created; dates validated (completed >= started when both present).

title: Asset Under Maintenance while work is open; returned to service on completion (J-4)
objective: Verify opening maintenance moves the asset to Under Maintenance (blocking assignment), and completing the record returns it to an assignable status with result + next-due set.
preconditions: Asset M2 with open maintenance record.
test_data: completion payload {completed date, result 'Repaired', next_due or interval-derived}
steps: Open maintenance on M2; verify asset status = Under Maintenance.
Attempt to assign M2 while under maintenance → expect 409.
POST /maintenance/<uuid>/complete with result.
Verify asset status returns to assignable state; next_maintenance_due calculated per interval; assignment now possible.
expected_result: Status transitions follow transition rules; conflicting lifecycle ops blocked during maintenance; completion sets result, completed date, and next-due (explicit or interval-derived, documented); full audit trail.

title: Maintenance cost restricted to finance-capable roles
objective: Verify maintenance cost fields serialize only for roles with finance.view (admin/manager/auditor); operator/employee/dept manager without finance capability do not receive cost data.
preconditions: Maintenance record with cost {amount, currency} on an asset visible to operator and auditor.
test_data: operator session; auditor session; manager session
steps: GET /maintenance/<uuid> (and asset history payloads) as operator, auditor, manager.
Compare serialized fields.
expected_result: Cost present for finance-capable roles as money object {amount decimal-string, currency}; absent/null for others; no cost leakage in list endpoints, activity feed summaries, or error messages.

title: Maintenance list filters and work queue (/maintenance page)
objective: Verify GET /maintenance supports filtering by status (open/completed), type, asset, date range with pagination envelope, and the /maintenance UI page renders the work list with correct states.
preconditions: Multiple maintenance records seeded/created across types and states.
test_data: filters: open only; type=Repair; date range last 30 days
steps: Query list with each filter; verify envelope {count,next,previous,results} and correct row sets.
Open /maintenance in browser as operator; verify list renders, filters apply, empty state shown when no matches.
expected_result: Server-side filtering correct and permission-scoped; pagination per D-09; UI shows loading/empty/error states; list matches API truth.

title: Warranty expiry windows computed and surfaced
objective: Verify assets within configurable warranty-expiry windows (e.g., 30/60/90 days) are identified by the dashboard/maintenance queries with correct counts and asset references.
preconditions: Seeded/created assets with warranty_end dates: expired, within 30d, within 90d, beyond 90d, none.
test_data: asset set spanning each warranty bucket
steps: Query dashboard summary warranty-expiring KPI (and any warranty listing endpoint per OpenAPI).
Verify bucket membership and counts against known data.
expected_result: Counts match ground truth for each window; expired assets distinguishable from expiring; scope filtering applied (dept-scoped user sees only own-scope assets); links lead to correctly filtered asset lists.

title: Warranty/expiry indicators not color-alone
objective: Verify warranty/expiry and maintenance-due indicators in UI use icon + text + semantic color with screen-reader text, never color alone.
preconditions: Assets with expiring/expired warranty visible in list + detail; browser runner.
test_data: asset list page; asset detail page
steps: Open asset register and an asset detail with expiring warranty.
Inspect indicator markup: icon, visible label, accessible name.
Verify at 200% zoom and with reduced motion that indicators remain perceivable.
expected_result: Every expiry/maintenance indicator has icon + text label + accessible description; information survives grayscale; no color-only signaling (layout §5.3 mapping).

title: E2E Journey J-4 — record repair and return to service
objective: UI journey: open maintenance on an asset, observe Under Maintenance state, complete the repair with result, verify return-to-service and history.
preconditions: Full stack seeded; Playwright; operator credentials.
test_data: asset with no open maintenance; repair details; result 'Repaired'
steps: From asset detail, create maintenance record via UI form (validation: submit empty first, verify errors).
Verify Under Maintenance badge (icon+text) and blocked assign action in UI.
Complete the maintenance via UI with result + notes.
Verify badge cleared, history shows open+complete events, and asset assignable again.
expected_result: Journey matches backend truth at each step; form validation UX per design §8.5 (error summary, focus management); no optimistic success; evidence screenshots captured.
